name: get_user_profile
description: Get any member's profile by their member ID. Only use this for fetching OTHER members' profiles or if the current member updates their information. Never call this for the logged-in member — their profile is already in the system prompt.

user_id.description: The member ID in format PT-XXXX

name: log_workout
description: Log a completed workout for the current member. Automatically determine the body_part from the exercise name.

exercise.description: Name of the exercise e.g. bench press, squat, deadlift

weight_kg.description: Weight used in kilograms. Use 0 for bodyweight exercises.

body_part.description: Primary muscle group targeted. Determine this automatically from the exercise name. Options: chest, back, shoulders, arms, legs, core, cardio, full body

name: get_workout_history
description: Get workout history for the current member. Always call this before creating a new workout plan to understand what they have already done.

days.description: Number of past days to retrieve. Default is 7.

body_part.description: Optional filter by body part e.g. chest, legs, back. Leave empty to get all workouts.

name: generate_workout_plan
description: Generate a personalized workout plan for the current member. Use the member profile from the system prompt to personalize — consider their fitness level, goals, and injuries. Never recommend exercises that could worsen existing injuries. Use the member's default days_per_week from their profile unless they explicitly say a different number in the conversation.

days_per_week.description: How many days per week the member can train. Always use the value from the member profile unless the member explicitly mentions a different number in the conversation.

focus.description: Optional specific focus area e.g. chest, legs, cardio, full body. Leave empty for a balanced plan based on member goals.
